components.css: .cube-action { font: 600 14px system-ui,sans-serif; min-height:46px; padding:11px 16px; color:#fff; background:var(--accent,#3552ba); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:9px; cursor:pointer; } .cube-action:hover { background:var(--accent-hover,#29439d); } .cube-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #3c60d4; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: The real puzzle leads; manual or reviewed local photo entry, a clear reference frame, and readable per-move teaching support it.
dos: Keep the cube and current action usable together on phones.
Distinguish solution verification from the current solved state.
Require alignment and explicit color review before committing each photo face.
donts: Do not change the logical reference frame when moving the camera.
Do not present color estimates as confirmed input or promise automatic unseen-face scanning.
